sampling: Uniform image sampling of LAB94 plus the selected field budget; same fourfold augmented dataset repetition as v1.
zero_field_control: Existing holes_lab_s42; no field coordinates used for training or checkpoint selection.
development_evaluation: Automatic features on fold TRAIN and VAL only; predicted-coordinate scales fit on all TRAIN sessions; evaluate all VAL frames and the 8 manually annotated VAL images.
rules: No TEST images or TEST point coordinates enter development feature extraction, checkpoint selection, or calibration.
All 40 human annotations are frozen; each fold has its own train/val/test roles.
Field point budgets exclude the separately reported LAB images, field validation coordinates, and class labels used for calibration.
Use v1 geometry and peak thresholds unchanged in this first adaptation experiment.
Existing LAB-only failure is retained. No operational model weights, pseudo coordinates, radar labels, or VLM are used.
This development comparison is not a new independent test and does not claim method superiority.
GPU may be shared. Do not use these runtimes as paper latency measurements.
